trades.ask: I'll swap you an Engraved Slate Coaster for 3 Blackberries. It's been on the mantelpiece long enough.
trades.thanks: Go on then, it's yours. Look after it.

trades.ask: Bring me a Cut-glass Decanter and I'll swap you Chapbook: Sheepdog Herd for it. I've read it twice and my knees have had enough.
trades.thanks: Lovely. That'll look grand on the sideboard. The pamphlet's yours, mind how you go.

trades.ask: Aye, it's Sheep Wool, three of them I'm short of. Help me out and a Blue football scarf is yours.
Aye, one day I'll stop running out of home-made cumberland sausage. Until then, a pair of lancashire clogs for Home-made Cumberland Sausage, just the one.
Now then, Brown Trout, just the one, that's my whole wish list. £300 for your trouble.
trades.thanks: Well, that's made my week. Take this.

trades.ask: Now then, it's Parsnips, four of them I'm short of. Help me out and £330 is yours.
trades.thanks: There you go. Don't spend it all at once.

trades.ask: Now then, I've had a notion for Hawthorn Berries, five of them all week. A Water Snare says you'll oblige.
